Maya: started a 0.8% canary for rwd-nlg v3.4-int4 on the chat route. p50/p95 latency wins, but QA and api-doc slices show regressions. dropping quick numbers.

Evan: paste slice table pls.

Maya: short table (1.9k samples):
```
slice | base_RL | v3.4_int4_RL | delta
qa-short | 0.71 | 0.66 | -7.0%
api-doc | 0.73 | 0.69 | -5.5%
short | 0.82 | 0.80 | -2.4%
```

Liu: any sign it's hallucination vs tokenization?

Maya: diffs show entity swaps and wrong numeric spans; hallucination_per1k up from 10 -> 26. used per-channel int4 with topk clamp. config snippet: `quant: pchan_int4, clamp: top0.2%, seed: 9001`.

Marta: gate stance: hold at 0.8%. for auto-fallback propose min_samples=1800, window=30m, required_triggers=2. Triggers: rougeL_drop_pct <= -3.0, halluc_per1k_abs >= 4. Also require sample floor per-slice.

Evan: add composite score where hallucination weighted x2. require composite > 0.25 for auto-fallback. also debounce for 2 consecutive windows.

Liu: I'll reproduce quant locally with seed 9001 and run the top-1k QA exact-match suite.

Maya: action items: Maya -> run 12k targeted QA sweep and post top-200 failures; Liu -> local replicate + exact-match; Marta -> lock escalation and patch gate config with the min_samples/window/required_triggers.

gate-bot: Canary digest (v3.4-int4) — traffic 0.8% for 35m, samples=1900, p50 latency -11%, p95 -16%, token-cost -31%, fallback_state=not_triggered.

Marta: ok keep this thread canonical. if targeted human review shows <=1% critical factual errors and composite_score <0.2 we can move to 3%. otherwise iterate on clamp/calib. :white_check_mark:
